description: List a link, API, x402 endpoint, MCP server or dataset on the YRUZ x402 Promo Board for exactly 24 hours (directory, leaderboards, machine-readable catalogue). Send title and url; category and type are optional. The destination is checked before payment and a refused link is not charged. Returns the listing id and an owner_token: keep both for promo_renew_listing and promo_takeover_top_spot. Price: 0.02 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"promo_create_listing"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/promo/create?title=My+x402+API&url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com&category=api&type=api&description=What+it+does%2C+in+one+sentence

category.description: one of api, x402, mcp, data, ai, devtools, crypto, saas, open-source, media, other (default other; synonyms such as tools, dataset, mcp-server are mapped)

provider.description: display name, up to 80 characters, optional

type.description: one of website, api, x402-endpoint, mcp-server, dataset, developer-tool, agent-service, open-source, other (default: guessed from the URL)

url.description: public http(s) URL to promote, https:// is added when missing (required), aliases link, website; with an agent Bearer token or a profile x-auth-token it defaults to your YRUZ profile

name: promo_create_listing
title: YRUZ Promo Board Listing (0.02 USDC)
